newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon boosts IBM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon boosts IBM.

text.p: -- Salomon analyst John Jones said he upgraded International Business Machines Corp to strong buy from buy, citing rising near-term confidence in the computer maker's fundamentals.
-- Jones said he was maintaining his earnings estimates for the 1996 and 1997 years but added, "I think there's some possibility for upside near-term."
-- He set a 12-month target price of $145.

-- The analyst said his rising confidence in IBM's near-term prospects was tied in part to a series of announcements the company has scheduled for September 10, which include a new version of the microrprocessors used to power its core mainframe computer products. These chips are known as CMOS, or Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductors.
-- "As of September 10, they will have refreshed all of their major product lines during the last nine months," he said.
